请按这条规则修改 Page.tsx:只改和这条规则有关的地方,其他部分保持原样;如果页面已经符合这条规则,就不要改,直接结束。改了就运行检查。

Current: Section "链路明细" with Group title `${chain.product} · ${chain.version}` — needs verdict appended. FigureLabel needs ` · {id}` when issue hits.

Section "发现问题" — has columns 编号/产品/步骤/问题/证据/严重度. The rule requires first column `位置` = `{product} 第 {step} 步 · {screen}`. So restructure columns: 位置 (span 3?), 编号, 问题, 证据, 严重度. Let's design: span sum = 9. 位置 span 3, 编号 1, 问题 2, 证据 2, 严重度 1. That's 9. Good.

Rows sorted as described.

Let me write the code with helper functions.

I'll restructure:

```tsx
const chainOf = (product: string) => data.chains.find((chain) => chain.product === product)

const issueOf = (product: string, step: number) =>
  data.issues.find((issue) => issue.product === product && issue.step === step)

const orderedIssues = data.issues
  .map((issue, index) => ({ issue, index }))
  .sort((a, b) => {
    const ai = data.chains.findIndex((chain) => chain.product === a.issue.product)
    const bi = data.chains.findIndex((chain) => chain.product === b.issue.product)
    const av = ai === -1 ? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER : ai
    const bv = bi === -1 ? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER : bi
    if (av !== bv) return av - bv
    if (a.issue.step !== b.issue.step) return a.issue.step - b.issue.step
    return a.index - b.index
  })
  .map(({ issue }) => {
    const chain = chainOf(issue.product)
    const step = chain?.steps.find((s) => s.no === issue.step)
    return {
      ...issue,
      where: step
        ? `${issue.product} 第 ${issue.step} 步 · ${step.screen}`
        : `${issue.product} 第 ${issue.step} 步`,
    }
  })
```

Note: spreading issue adds keys id, product, step, title, severity, evidence, plus where. Fine.

FigureLabel: 
```tsx
const hit = issueOf(chain.product, step.no)
<FigureLabel>
  第 {step.no} 步 · {step.screen}
  {hit ? ` · ${hit.id}` : ""}
</FigureLabel>
```
Careful with whitespace in JSX; using template is cleaner:
```tsx
<FigureLabel>{`第 ${step.no} 步 · ${step.screen}${hit ? ` · ${hit.id}` : ""}`}</FigureLabel>
```

Group title: `${chain.product} · ${chain.version} · ${chain.verdict}`.

Section description for 链路明细: mentions steps; maybe add that labels note problem ids. Keep mostly. I'll update to "三款 App 从进入退货到提交成功的完整步骤,命中问题的步骤标注问题编号". And section 发现问题 description: "4 个问题的位置与依据,位置对应链路明细" — but must be a general description. Change from "按严重度标注" to "位置与链路明细对应,严重度按影响范围评定".
